sentences.text: Ontario's Health Services Restructuring Commission released a vision document in January 1997 that included a description of the desirable characteristics and overall structure of Ontario's health services system, which was used as the basis for developing a policy framework and making recommendations to the Minister of Health on steps and strategies required to proceed from vision to actual system-building.

The Health Services Restructuring Commission issued Change and Transition: Planning Guidelines and Implementation Strategies for Home Care, Long term Care, Mental Health, Rehabilitation, and Sub-acute Care in 1998.
To co-ordinate the planning, implementation and ongoing monitoring of mental health services in central west Ontario, existing management structures were to be used for a limited duration.

The Health Services Restructuring Commission advised the Minister of Health to cease the operation of mental health services at the Hamilton Psychiatric Hospital by April 30, 2000, and pending the closure, to transfer the governance and management of mental health services at the Hamilton Psychiatric Hospital to the St. Joseph's Hospital.
